description: This file defines the RepeatedFieldCodec<T> class which implements serialization and deserialization logic for the RepeatedField<T> data structure used within Orleans serialization framework, specifically for handling Google Protobuf collections.

classes.name: RepeatedFieldCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer class for RepeatedField<T> type, implementing the IFieldCodec interface for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a RepeatedField<T> instance into a writer, including length and element data.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from a reader to produce a RepeatedField<T> instance, handling references and length-prefixed collection elements.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Helper method that throws an exception if the serialized size exceeds the expected bounds.

methods.name: ThrowLengthFieldMissing
methods.description: Helper method that throws if the length field for the RepeatedField is missing during deserialization.
